For with the measure you use, it will be measured to you."* (Luke 6:38) 2. **Serving Others with Love (1 Timothy 5:18, Matthew 10:10)** - Tipping is a way to honor those who serve you (e.g., waitstaff, maids, drivers) as Jesus honored those who worked for Him. - *"The worker deserves his wages"* (1 Timothy 5:18, quoting Luke 10:7). - Jesus even told His disciples to carry a purse for their needs (Matthew 10:10), implying that those who serve should be supported. 3. **The Heart Behind the Action (2 Corinthians 8:7-9)** - Paul encourages giving cheerfully, not out of obligation but from a heart of love. - *"Each of you should give what you have decided in your heart to give, not reluctantly or under compulsion, for God loves a cheerful giver."* (2 Corinthians 9:7) ### **Was Charlie’s Action Right or Wrong?** - **Legally?** No, tipping is not always mandatory, but it is expected in many cultures. - **Ethically/Biblically?** **Wrong in spirit**, because: - It fails to honor the hard work of the server (Proverbs 12:10). - It misses an opportunity to reflect Christ’s generosity (Luke 6:38). - It may discourage the server, who relies on tips for fair wages. ### **What Should Charlie Have Done?** - **Give a fair tip** (at least 15-20% in many places) as an act of gratitude and justice. - **Pray about it**—if he genuinely couldn’t afford it, he could ask God for wisdom on how to give sacrificially in other areas.
